findings.title: Preserve right alignment in the legacy box fallback
findings.body: The new `flexbox()` mixin enables `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` on older engines, but that legacy box model does not distribute free space to auto margins. In those browsers, replacing `float: right` with `margin-left: auto` leaves `.panel` beside the logo/topic information instead of at the header’s right edge. Wide dropdowns right-anchored to this panel can consequently extend off the left side of the viewport. Provide a working legacy alignment mechanism, such as a flexible spacer, or retain a non-box fallback for those engines.
